correctness.rationale: An interleaving is exactly one length-eight binary word with four A and four B, so there are 70 distinct concept masks and the 16 available queries compare the i-th A and j-th B. Independent complete exhaustive Python computation generated all 70 masks and evaluated every query and the full memoized minimax shattering recurrence (Ldim C = 1+max_q min(Ldim C0,Ldim C1) where both children nonempty). It obtained Ldim on square profiles n=1,2,3,4 equal to 1,2,4,5; all four diagonal queries 4x4 split 35/35. The package provides an exact finite integer-exhaustion certificate: only those four roots could support 2^5=32 witnesses per child, endpoints fail because S_{3,4} best first split is 15/20, and for the middle q22 a unique 17/18 split branches into 9/9 children lacking any 4/4 split. A constructive first-elements deletion argument supplies depth5. The finite exhaustion here is exhaustive for the EXACT finite 70-concept domain, not an extrapolation to larger chains.
